my-image-mcp tools

my-image-mcp gives an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients) a toolbox of 99 image tools built on OpenCV, libvips and ImageMagick. You don't call these tools yourself: ask the assistant in plain language (for example "count the coins in photo.jpg and outline them") and it picks the tools. This page shows what it can do.

Images stay in memoryEach result gets a short name like img_3. The original is never changed: every step makes a new image, so the assistant can compare and go back.
Numbers, not just picturesMany tools also return measurements (counts, areas, positions, scores) that the assistant can reason about and report to you.
Colors and boxesColors are written like #ff0000, red or 255,0,0. Positions are in pixels from the top-left corner; boxes are [x, y, width, height].
RequirementsOpenCV and libvips tools always work. ImageMagick tools need ImageMagick 7 installed on the computer running the server.
Backend:

load_image

ioOpenCV

Open an image file: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, AVIF, SVG, GIF and, with ImageMagick, HEIC (iPhone photos), JPEG XL, PDF pages, PSD and camera RAW. Photos are auto-rotated and their colors converted to standard sRGB.

Details and parameters
Load an image file into memory and return its handle. Reads png, jpg, tiff, webp, bmp, AVIF,
SVG, GIF and, when ImageMagick is installed, HEIC (iPhone photos), JPEG XL, PDF, PSD and camera RAW.

'color' gives 3-channel BGR, 'grayscale' 1-channel, 'unchanged' keeps alpha and 16-bit depth.
EXIF orientation is applied and embedded color profiles (Display P3, Adobe RGB...) are converted
to sRGB. page selects a PDF page / GIF frame / TIFF page (0-based); dpi sets PDF/SVG resolution.
Relative paths are resolved against the server's first root directory.
ParameterTypeDefaultNotes
pathtextrequiredFile path; relative paths resolve against the server root
mode"color" | "grayscale" | "unchanged""color"
pageinteger0
dpinumber150.0

save_image

ioOpenCV

Write an image to disk. The format follows the file extension (PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, AVIF, GIF, and HEIC/JPEG XL/PDF/PSD with ImageMagick).

Details and parameters
Save an image to a file; the format follows the extension: .png, .jpg, .webp, .tif, .bmp,
.avif, .gif and, with ImageMagick installed, .heic, .jxl, .pdf, .psd.

quality (0-100) applies to lossy formats; png uses lossless compression. Parent folders are created.
ParameterTypeDefaultNotes
imagetextrequiredImage handle (e.g. 'img_1')
pathtextrequiredFile path; relative paths resolve against the server root
qualityinteger95

Convert between color spaces. Images are BGR by default (OpenCV convention).

cv_call

genericOpenCV

Call any other OpenCV function directly (file, window and video functions are blocked).

Details and parameters
Call any OpenCV function (or a method of a stored OpenCV object) directly.
Argument encoding: handle strings ('img_3') -> stored values (copied, never modified);
'cv2.THRESH_BINARY | cv2.THRESH_OTSU' -> constants; {"$array": [[...]], "dtype": "float32"} -> numpy;
{"$tuple": [...]} -> tuple. Returned images/large arrays/objects become new handles; small values are
returned inline. File, GUI and video I/O functions are blocked.
ParameterTypeDefaultNotes
functiontextrequirede.g. 'GaussianBlur', 'ximgproc.niBlackThreshold', 'obj_2.detect'
argslist of any (optional)nullPositional arguments
kwargsobject (optional)nullKeyword arguments
